title: Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XII OF 2001
PAKISTAN ATOMIC ENERGY
COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 2001
ORDINANCE
XII OF 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of-Pakistan
, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th March,
2001]
F.No.2(1)/2001-Pub., dated
10-3-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information---
1 . Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance
may be called the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission (Amendment) Ordinance,
2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

[Gazette of-Pakistan
, Extraordinary, Part I, 10th March,
2001]
F.No.2(1)/2001-Pub., dated
10-3-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information---
2. Amendment of section 4, Ordinance XII of 1965.--In the Pakistan Atomic Energy Commission
Ordinance, 1965 (XVII of 1965), hereinafter referred to as the said
Ordinance, in section 4,--
(a) in subsection (1)
(i) clause (aa)
shall be omitted
(ii) in clause
(c) for the word "three" the word "five' shall be substituted;
and
(iii) clause (f)
shall be omitted
(b) in subsection(2),
(i) the comma
and words ",Deputy Chairman" shall be omitted; and
(ii) the words
"except the-ex officio member" shall -be omitted; and
(c) in subsection (3), the words
"the Deputy Chairman and" shall be omitted

Laboratories the words "or Projects" shall be inserted;

"(d) three scientists to be
